{"id":2069922439,"question_id":4242,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 week","timestamp":1784209370,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"63 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2069922439/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Sum of GCD of Formed Pairs","memory":"161.1 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n\n    long long gcdSum(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        vector<ll>pref(n);\n        pref[0] = nums[0];\n\n        ll maxi = nums[0];\n\n        for(int i = 1 ; i<n ; i++) \n        {\n            maxi = max(maxi , (ll)nums[i]);\n            pref[i] = gcd(maxi , (ll)nums[i]);\n        }\n\n        sort(begin(pref) , end(pref));\n\n        ll sum = 0;\n        for(int i = 0 , j = n-1 ; i<j ; i++ , j--)\n        {\n            sum += (gcd(pref[i] , pref[j]));\n        }\n        return sum;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"sum-of-gcd-of-formed-pairs","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2335}
